title: When Thou Wert Crucified by Men
description: When Thou Wert Crucified by Men in Tonic Solfa to SELENA, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 1 verses and a piano.
about: John Brownlie translated these words from the Greek service books for Hymns of the Greek Church (Edinburgh and London, 1900).
The book printed the words without tunes. They are in Long Metre, six lines (8.8.8.8.8.8), and this page sets them to SELENA; any other Long Metre, six lines tune fits them as well.
underlay: When Thou wert cru-ci-fied by men, O Christ, for Thy com-pan-ion then Thou didst ac-cept the base and vile, Whose hand was stained with blood the while; O, num-ber us with him, we pray! Thou who art good and kind al-way.

lines: When Thou wert crucified by men,
O Christ, for Thy companion then
Thou didst accept the base and vile,
Whose hand was stained with blood the while;
O, number us with him, we pray!
Thou who art good and kind alway.

source: John Brownlie, Hymns of the Greek Church (1900)
licence: Public domain: John Brownlie died in 1925.
credits: Translated by John Brownlie (1857–1925) from the Greek, public domain, as printed in Hymns of the Greek Church; set to SELENA by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
